definitions.explanation: For something to commence or start happening. An intransitive verb describing the beginning of an event, action, or state.

examples.japanese: {授業|じゅぎょう}は9{時|じ}に{始|はじ}まります。
{映画|えいが}が{始|はじ}まりました。
{春|はる}が{始|はじ}まりましたね。

notes: This is an intransitive verb (something begins by itself). The transitive counterpart is {始|はじ}める (to start something). {始|はじ}まる describes events starting, while {始|はじ}める is used when someone initiates an action.
